panels.title: Average LCP
panels.description: Average Largest Contentful Paint over the selected time range. Good is ≤2.5 seconds.

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time({source="faro"} | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="web-vitals" | value_lcp != "" | unwrap value_lcp [$__range]))

panels.title: Average CLS
panels.description: Average Cumulative Layout Shift over the selected time range. Good is ≤0.10.

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time({source="faro"} | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="web-vitals" | value_cls != "" | unwrap value_cls [$__range]))

panels.title: Average FCP
panels.description: Average First Contentful Paint over the selected time range. Good is ≤1.8 seconds.

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time({source="faro"} | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="web-vitals" | value_fcp != "" | unwrap value_fcp [$__range]))

panels.title: Average TTFB
panels.description: Average Time to First Byte over the selected time range.

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time({source="faro"} | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="web-vitals" | value_ttfb != "" | unwrap value_ttfb [$__range]))

panels.title: Web Vitals over time
panels.description: Raw Faro Web Vitals, parsed from browser telemetry in Loki.

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time({source="faro"} | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="web-vitals" | value_lcp != "" | unwrap value_lcp [$__interval]))
avg(avg_over_time({source="faro"} | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="web-vitals" | value_fcp != "" | unwrap value_fcp [$__interval]))
avg(avg_over_time({source="faro"} | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="web-vitals" | value_ttfb != "" | unwrap value_ttfb [$__interval]))

panels.title: Layout stability
panels.description: CLS values from Faro; lower is better.

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time({source="faro"} | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="web-vitals" | value_cls != "" | unwrap value_cls [$__interval]))

panels.title: P95 frontend API duration
panels.description: Browser-observed fetch duration for Mosaic API calls.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {source="faro"} | logfmt | event_name="faro.performance.resource" | event_data_initiatorType="fetch" | event_data_duration != "" | unwrap event_data_duration [$__interval])

panels.title: Browser errors and slow API calls
panels.description: Faro logs include traceID/spanID for fetch events; use them to investigate user-visible failures alongside Tempo.
